newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong gold closes up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold closes up in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold closed higher on Friday compared to New York's previous close in quiet trade, traders said.
Hong Kong bullion finished at US$325.00/50 per ounce, up from New York's Thursday close at $324.30/80 and the local open at US$324.10/60 per ounce.
Dealers expected gold to trade between U$322 and US$328 in the short term and said the market would remain quiet.
"It was quite quiet today, just lacklustre," a trader said.
Tael gold closed at HK$3,008 per tael, up from HK$3,001 per tael at the open but down from HK$3,018 on Thursday.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society was -5.00 from the previous fix at -4.00.
